parser.js extractCoverPrompts/extractTitleVariants — regex tolerates `1.`, `1)`, optional **bold**, optional [bracket], em-dash/colon variants. thumbnails_routes.py VIRAL_STYLE_SUFFIX (lines 60-67) — strong viral-aesthetic anchor language. Comment explicitly notes 'no text' was intentionally omitted to avoid double-up watermarks (nice pre-emptive bug-prevention).

Rewriter system prompt (lines 132-164) — comprehensive MUST INCLUDE bullets cover expressive subject, bold palette, dramatic lighting, curiosity gap, negative space + MUST AVOID list for typography/stock-photo cliches. Output cap 80-200 words is correctly enforced.

Backwards compat: extractCoverPrompts on legacy text returns []; sendToThumbnails falls through to seed-based handoff; Thumbnails.jsx Path B handles this with 'Pre-filled from your script' toast. Verified end-to-end via code path inspection.

Cost-confirmation modal (lines 604-648) — proper backdrop click-outside dismiss + e.stopPropagation on modal body + aria-labelledby. The 'X left after' subtotal uses quota.thumbnails_remaining safely with optional-chain + fallback.
Minor: line 132 system_prompt says '90-160 words' but the live test got 91 words for a 5-word input — bound is reasonable. Test asserts 60-260 word band; tighten if QA wants stricter adherence.
